about: The 3 v1 weapons. Each is a runtime clone (xNVSE CloneForm) of a vanilla Fallout: New Vegas weapon, so models, sounds and animations are the game's own and nothing from CS2 is used. Multipliers apply to the base weapon's own values read at runtime. Form IDs are from FalloutNV.esm (mod index 00); the scripts check every one at load and print a CSNV error line if one does not resolve.

columns.id: unique weapon id (also the aux-variable key the clone is stored under)
columns.name: in-game name (original, CS-flavoured, not a Valve trademark)
columns.base_form: FalloutNV.esm form ID of the vanilla weapon that is cloned
columns.base_name: the vanilla weapon's in-game name (for humans checking base_form)
columns.ammo_form: FalloutNV.esm form ID of the ammo given with the purchase
columns.damage_mult: multiplier on the base weapon's damage (SetAttackDamage)
columns.fire_rate_mult: multiplier on the base fire rate (SetWeaponFireRate)
columns.verified: true once bought and fired in the running game
